task: Fix MCPToolkit._create_tools() to stop silently dropping tools with unprocessable schemas, and relax _is_object_schema() to accept anyOf/oneOf at top level.

key_reasoning.reason: Two targeted changes: one exception-handler replacement in _create_tools() and one one-liner guard update in _is_object_schema(). Both inside the generic MCP tool-creation path.

Two source files: src/codemie/service/mcp/toolkit.py and src/codemie/core/json_schema_utils.py. No test files need changing — existing unit tests remain valid; the change only affects the failure path.

The fallback schema is identical to the existing no-inputSchema path, so it introduces no new runtime risk. The _is_object_schema change is safe for nested usage because anyOf/oneOf dispatch precedes that check in _schema_to_type_annotation.
